name: io.github.zaxcoraider/agentguard-mcp
title: AgentGuard
description: Let an AI agent pay on NEAR through a vault whose spending rules a contract enforces, not the agent.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Your AgentGuard vault account, e.g. my-agent.agentguard.testnet

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's ed25519 function-call key; without it the server is read-only

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a key file to read instead of AGENTGUARD_AGENT_KEY

environmentVariables.name: SENTINEL_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where to buy Sentinel's paid check
